segments.name: Loan Servicing and Systems
products: Servicing federally owned student loans for the Department
Servicing private education and consumer loans
Providing backup servicing for private education and consumer loans
segments.description: Services federal, FFELP and private education loans for the government, banks and schools, and supplies servicing software and outsourced contact center services.
segments.evidence: Includes the brands Nelnet Diversified Solutions, Nelnet Loan Servicing, Nelnet Servicing, Firstmark Services, Sloan Servicing, and Nelnet Government Services

segments.name: Education Technology Services and Payments
segments.description: Provides education and payment technology and services to schools, higher education institutions, and businesses in the United States and internationally.
segments.evidence: NBS provides education and payment technology and services for K-12 schools, higher education institutions, and businesses in the United States and internationally

segments.name: Asset Generation and Management
products: student and other loan assets, including residual interests therein
segments.description: Manages a portfolio of student and other loan assets for its own account and administers loans for third-party portfolio owners.
segments.evidence: AGM also derives revenue by providing loan administration services to third-party loan portfolio owners.

segments.name: Nelnet Bank
segments.description: Internet Utah-chartered industrial bank lending in the private education and unsecured consumer loan markets to borrowers.
segments.evidence: Internet Utah-chartered industrial bank focused on the private education and unsecured consumer loan markets

revenueModel.text: The government, schools, businesses and borrowers pay monthly servicing, software and payment fees, and borrowers pay interest on the loans the company holds.
revenueModel.evidence: Nelnet Servicing earns a monthly fee from the Department based on borrower volume it services on behalf of the Department.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company sold its ownership interests in Nelnet Renewable Energy, whose solar construction results had been reported outside the reportable segments.
changes.evidence: The Company sold its ownership interests in Nelnet Renewable Energy during the fourth quarter of 2025.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company discontinued its residential solar operations to focus exclusively on the commercial solar market.
changes.evidence: In April 2024, the Company announced a change in its solar EPC operations to focus exclusively on the commercial solar market and discontinued its residential solar operations.
